name: Witchy's Guide to Critical Reading
source:
"No one knows how to think critically anymore!"  You read someone post online.  "The future generations are doomed!" Well, isn't that a rather pessimistic outlook?

As it becomes more vital then ever to be more aware of the content being pushed out into the world, you may need to brush up on your critical reading and analysis skills. Why don't we have the biggest book lover of the Groovy Gang, Witchy, give us a few pointers?

This educational visual novel features Witchy teaching her younger sister and her group of friends the fundamentals of critical reading, how it can be applied to mediums other then written prose,  and contextualizes the advice to  fit into one's daily life in the digital age.

[From [url=https://puffyartist.itch.io/witchys-guide-to-critical-reading]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“没有人知道如何批判性思考了！”  你在网上阅读某人的帖子。“子孙后代都完蛋了！”嗯，这不是一个相当悲观的前景吗？

随着更加了解被推向世界的内容变得比以往任何时候都更加重要，你可能需要提高批判性阅读和分析技能。为什么我们没有Groovy Gang最大的图书爱好者Witchy给我们一些指点呢？

这部教育视觉小说的特点是，女巫教她的妹妹和她的一群朋友批判性阅读的基础知识，如何将其应用于书面散文以外的媒介，并将建议融入数字时代的日常生活中。

[来自[url=https://puffyartist.itch.io/witchys-guide-to-critical-reading]itch.io[/url]]
